units.basis: The raw page title identifies condensed consolidated cash flows. Its own narrative and printed header both say nine months ended 30 September; the two columns are ordered 2025 then 2024. R24-C2 declares the YTD starts for this period input. A separate capital-expenditure reconciliation schedule later on page 46 is not this cash-flow summary unit.

units.refusal_rationale: The five printed columns distinguish entities and a total, while the page supplies one nine-month reporting period. Repeating the same period five times would treat entity dimensions as time periods and create an ambiguous/non-period-mappable map. Do not map balances or entity columns as flows.
